_doc: The fixed held render (prompt 5Q, 2026-10-05). Windows start_hold pauses at sim t = 0.30; two holds on Pi-3 gave this render byte for byte. Every run's final held render must have this sha1 (hold_gate.sh); a different render fails the run. Model a38a664c.

npu_reference.note: gate_render.py all_dets (class, conf, w, h, cx, cy) on in-loop pixels of the held render, holds_5Q hold1 and hold2 identical. batch.sh checks it at the start and end of every session (1 NPU open each); a mismatch stops the batch.
